guide.title: Card income deduction essentials (tax year 2026)
items: Only spending above 25% of gross salary is deducted. The threshold is filled with low-rate credit card spending first.
Rates: credit 15%, debit/cash receipts 30%, books·shows·museums·sports 30% (gross salary up to 70M KRW), traditional markets and public transit 40%.
Basic limit: 3M KRW up to 70M gross salary, 2.5M above. +500K (250K above 70M) per dependent child, up to 2 children.
Extra limit: market, transit and culture deductions can go beyond the basic limit, up to 3M KRW combined (2M above 70M).
Insurance premiums, taxes and utility bills, apartment management fees, gift cards, overseas spending and new car purchases don't count (used cars: 10% of the price).
Spending by a spouse or lineal relatives with income of 1M KRW or less can be added (not siblings).
guide.source: Basis: Restriction of Special Taxation Act Art. 126-2 and Enforcement Decree Art. 121-2 (tax year 2026). Confirm actual amounts with Hometax's simplified year-end data, opening January 15.
